summary: Diamond Peak's 1934 pole tower and L-4 cab came down about 1960; a patrol tower a short hike away was still standing in the 1980s.

facts.status_note: Summit tower gone since about 1960; captions describe its footings, and a patrol tower stood nearby.

access.note: A year-round gate sits just before Petit Lake; Willhite says the road was closed in the late 1990s to protect grizzly bear habitat.

visit.trail_note: Hiking distance 1.8 miles with 800 ft gain (start point not stated); fair gravel roads run to the gate; add 0.7 miles for the patrol point.

events.note: About 1960; the register says removed, Willhite says destroyed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Both sources put the end of the summit tower at about 1960. The register says removed; Willhite says destroyed.

sources.title: Diamond Peak Lookout Site (Kaniksu NF), US 1493

notes_for_editor: Patrol tower 'still stands' is undated on Willhite; the register dates it only to the 1980s. The access level 'restricted' is inferred from the year-round gate and the 1990s closure; no source states the legal status. Two web search hits (SummitPost, Trailchick) mention summit foundations and a 2018 visit; not verified on a fetched page, so left out.
